title: WX-500 STORMSCOPE - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the key features and range capabilities of the WX-500 Stormscope?
answer: The maintenance practices give the removal and installation procedures for the stormscope, which is installed in the tailcone, aft of the baggage divider.The WX- 500 Stormscope shows lightning information at ranges of 200 nmi.  It is designed to interface with Garmin's Control Display Unit  or Honeywell's multi-function display . The stormscope does an analysis of the radiated signals of electrical discharges from storm cells to find thunderstorms. The information is then used to give the location and intensity of dangerous thunderstorms.

title: WX-500 STORMSCOPE - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the specific steps to safely remove and reinstall the Stormscope antenna on the aircraft's fuselage, including preparation, disconnecting and reattaching the coaxial cable, and ensuring proper reassembly?
answer: Remove the Stormscope Antenna . (1) Make sure the MASTER and AVIONICS switches are in the off position. (2) Remove the baggage compartment lower access panel. Refer to Chapter 25, Interior Upholstery - Maintenance Practices. (3) Disconnect the coaxial cable  from the antenna. (4)  Remove the screws that attach the antenna to the bottom of the fuselage.Install the Stormscope Antenna . (1) Put the stormscope antenna in position on the bottom of the fuselage. (3) Attach the coaxial cable  to the antenna. Install the baggage compartment lower access panel. Refer to Chapter 25, Interior Upholstery

title: WX-500 STORMSCOPE - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the detailed procedures for removing and reinstalling the Stormscope, including disconnecting electrical connections and accessing the tailcone?
answer: Remove the Stormscope . (1) Make sure the MASTER and AVIONICS switches are in the off position. (2)  Remove the tailcone access/inspection plate  to get access to the stormscope. Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation. (3) Disconnect the electrical connection. (4)  Loosen the knurled nut that holds the stormscope in position. (5) Remove the stormscope from the airplane.Install the Stormscope . (1) Set the stormscope in position on the tray and tighten the knurled nut. (2) Connect the electrical connection. (3)  Install the tailcone access/inspection plate . Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation.

title: WX-500 STORMSCOPE - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the specific steps to safely remove and reinstall the Stormscope antenna while ensuring proper disconnection and reattachment of the coaxial cable?
answer: Remove the Stormscope Antenna . (1) Make sure the MASTER and AVIONICS switches are in the off position. (2) Remove the baggage compartment lower access panel. Refer to Chapter 25, Interior Upholstery - Maintenance Practices. (3) Disconnect the coaxial cable  from the antenna. (4)  Remove the screws that attach the antenna to the bottom of the fuselage.Install the Stormscope Antenna . (1) Put the stormscope antenna in position on the bottom of the fuselage. (3) Attach the coaxial cable  to the antenna. Install the baggage compartment lower access panel. Refer to Chapter 25, Interior Upholstery

title: WX-500 STORMSCOPE - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the detailed procedures for removing and reinstalling the Stormscope, including ensuring the aircraft's electrical system is off and access to the tailcone is properly obtained?
answer: Remove the Stormscope . (1) Make sure the MASTER and AVIONICS switches are in the off position. (2)  Remove the tailcone access/inspection plate  to get access to the stormscope. Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation. (3) Disconnect the electrical connection. (4)  Loosen the knurled nut that holds the stormscope in position. (5) Remove the stormscope from the airplane.Install the Stormscope . (1) Set the stormscope in position on the tray and tighten the knurled nut. (2) Connect the electrical connection. (3)  Install the tailcone access/inspection plate . Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation.
